disciplinary_grounds.description: Licensee has failed to pay any fee or charge properly imposed by the Administrator.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee or any entity or individual subject to the Oklahoma Pawnshop Act has failed to pay any fee or charge properly imposed by the Administrator under the authority of the Oklahoma Pawnshop Act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Licensee has violated any provision of the Oklahoma Pawnshop Act or any rule or order lawfully made pursuant to it.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee, either knowingly or without the exercise of due care to prevent the same, has violated any provision of the Oklahoma Pawnshop Act or any rule or order lawfully made pursuant to and within the authority of the Oklahoma Pawnshop Act

disciplinary_grounds.description: A fact or condition exists which, if known at the time of original application, would have justified refusal of the license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any fact or condition exists which, if it had existed or had been known to exist at the time of the original application for a license, clearly would have justified the Administrator in refusing the license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful noncompliance of a pawnbroker with a written hold order.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful noncompliance of a pawnbroker to a written hold order shall be cause for the pawnbroker's license to either be suspended or revoked pursuant to paragraph 2 of subsection B of Section 1507 of this title.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Licensee fails or refuses to permit the Administrator or authorized representative to examine or copy books or relevant documents.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any licensee who fails or refuses to permit the Administrator or duly authorized representative or any authorized peace officer to examine or make copies of such books or other relevant documents shall thereby be deemed in violation of the Oklahoma Pawnshop Act and such failure or refusal shall constitute grounds for the suspension or revocation of such license.

bonding_required.quote: Each applicant for a pawnshop license at the time of filing application shall file with the Administrator a bond satisfactory to him and in the amount of Five Thousand Dollars ($5,000.00) for each license with a surety company qualified to do business in this state.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: A separate license shall be required for each pawnshop operated under the Oklahoma Pawnshop Act.

definition_quote.value: a person engaged in the business of making pawn transactions
definition_quote.quote: "Pawnbroker" means a person engaged in the business of making pawn transactions.

value: lending money on the security of pledged goods
purchasing tangible personal property on condition that it may be redeemed or repurchased by the seller for a fixed price within a fixed period of time
methods_authorized.quote: "Pawn transaction" means the act of lending money on the security of pledged goods or the act of purchasing tangible personal property on condition that it may be redeemed or repurchased by the seller for a fixed price within a fixed period of time.

surety_bond_required.quote: Each applicant for a pawnshop license at the time of filing application shall file with the Administrator a bond satisfactory to him and in the amount of Five Thousand Dollars ($5,000.00) for each license with a surety company qualified to do business in this state.

surety_bond_amount_usd.quote: a bond satisfactory to him and in the amount of Five Thousand Dollars ($5,000.00) for each license

bond_per_location.quote: a bond satisfactory to him and in the amount of Five Thousand Dollars ($5,000.00) for each license

max_interest_rate_annual_pct.quote: no pawn finance charge calculated according to the actuarial method shall exceed an amount equal to twenty percent (20%) of the amount financed which does not exceed Two Hundred Fifty Dollars ($250.00), financed for one (1) month; fifteen percent (15%) of that amount financed which is more than Two Hundred Fifty Dollars ($250.00) but does not exceed Five Hundred Dollars ($500.00), financed for one (1) month; ten percent (10%) of that amount financed which is more than Five Hundred Dollars ($500.00) but does not exceed One Thousand Dollars ($1,000.00), financed for one (1) month; and five percent (5%) of that amount financed which is more than One Thousand Dollars ($1,000.00), but does not exceed Five Thousand Dollars ($5,000.00), financed for one (1) month; three percent (3%) of that amount financed which is more than Five Thousand Dollars ($5,000.00) but does not exceed Twenty-five Thousand Dollars ($25,000.00), financed for one (1) month.

installment_loans_prohibited.quote: Enter any pawn transaction which has a maturity date more than one (1) month after the date of the transaction

pawn_ticket_required.quote: The declaration of ownership shall appear on the bill of sale or pawn ticket, to be completed by the seller or the pledgor at the time of the transaction.

value: name and address of the pawnbroker
name and address of the customer and the customer's description or the distinctive number from customer's driver's license or military identification
net amount paid to, receivable by, or paid or payable for the account of the customer (amount financed)
amount of the pawn finance charge (finance charge)
rate of the pawn finance charge (annual percentage rate)
total amount which must be paid to redeem the pledged goods on the maturity date (total of payments)
identification of the property to which any security interest relates, including serial numbers if reasonably available
maturity date of the pawn transaction
statement that the customer is not obligated to redeem the pledged goods and that the pledged goods may be forfeited thirty days after the maturity date
pawn_ticket_required_fields.quote: The pawnbroker shall give the customer the following information: a. the name and address of the pawnbroker; b. the name and address of the customer and the customer's description or the distinctive number from customer's driver's license or military identification; c. the date of the transaction; d. the net amount paid to, receivable by, or paid or payable for the account of the customer, designated as "amount financed"; e. the amount of the pawn finance charge, designated as "finance charge"; f. the rate of the pawn finance charge as applied to the amount financed ... designated as "annual percentage rate"; g. the total amount which must be paid to redeem the pledged goods on the maturity date, designated as the "total of payments"; h. an identification of the property to which any security interest held or to be retained or acquired relates, and shall include serial numbers if reasonably available; i. the maturity date of the pawn transaction; and j. a statement to the effect that the customer is not obligated to redeem the pledged goods

pledger_identity_verification_required.quote: Accept collateral or buy merchandise from a person unable to supply verification of identity by photo I.D. by either a state-issued identification card, driver's license or federal government-issued identification card or by readable fingerprint of right or left index finger on the back of the pawn or buy transaction copy to be retained for the pawnbroker's record.

records_retention_period_years.quote: Each licensee shall preserve or make available such books and records in this state relating to each of its pawn transactions for four (4) years from the date of the transaction, or two (2) years from the date of the final entry made thereon, whichever is later.

annual_report_due_date.value: May 1 (or other date fixed by the Administrator)
annual_report_due_date.quote: Each licensee shall, annually on or before the first day of May or other date thereafter fixed by the Administrator, file a report with the Administrator

minimum_pledger_age.quote: Accept a pledge or purchase property from a person, male or female, under the age of eighteen (18) years

unredeemed_pledge_min_hold_days_before_s.quote: Pledged goods not redeemed by the customer on or before the date fixed as the maturity date for the transaction in the pawn agreement or disclosure statement delivered, shall be held by the pawnbroker for at least thirty (30) days following such date

license_nontransferable.quote: The license shall not be transferable or assignable except upon approval by the Administrator of Consumer Credit.

one_license_per_location.quote: A separate license shall be required for each pawnshop operated under the Oklahoma Pawnshop Act.

municipal_license_also_required.quote: No licensing requirement or license fee shall be required, levied or collected by any municipal corporation of this state; provided that municipal corporations may require the payment of regulatory fees not in excess of Fifty Dollars ($50.00) per annum.

stolen_property_reporting_required.quote: Any pawnbroker shall make available a copy or report within two (2) days of any buy or pawn transaction to the local law enforcement agency of the municipality or other political subdivision in which the pawnshop is located
